notes.title: Tale of Toast Early Access Launch!
notes.content:
We are extremely happy to officially launch on Early Access. You can now download and play the game!

We can't express how happy we are to have such a great community that's been working together to make this Early Access happen!
If there is one thing more we can ask of you is to please help us spreading the word about Tale of Toast in the coming days! :)

For launch, we have set up two servers - one in US (West) and one in Europe (Germany).

[h1]Bounty Program[/h1]
As you know, the items in the Crumbs shop will now start costing actual money.
We understand that not everyone have the ability to purchase Crumbs, so we have introduced a Bounty Program!
This program allows you to earn Crumbs by promoting Tale of Toast.

Each participant can earn a minimum 1 crumb and maximum 500 crumbs per category:
[list]
[*] Social Media (Reddit, Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, etc)
[*] Videos (Youtube, etc)
[*] Stream (Twitch, etc)
[*] Blog Post/Article
[*] Other (anything really goes here, have a Tale of Toast event at school, add posters at your local mall, etc.)
[/list]

The decision as to how many crumbs are awarded per category to each will be based on total amount of views, shares, upvotes, etc. This means you are free to make multiple blog posts, multiple instagram posts, etc.
The goal of this program is to bring awareness of Toast, [b]but be very careful to follow best practises on each platform so you do not spam or break any other rules![/b]
You can also improve your chances by doing multiple streams, multiple Instagram posts, etc.
On top of awarding crumbs to each participant, we will also be giving a special unique title and in-game pet (designed per your wishes, subject to approval) for your account only to the one gaining most crumbs.

Example what a user could do:
Creates a reddit post explaining Tale of Toast. The post gets 200 upvotes and comments.
Posts a tweet about the launch of the game with a link to the steam page that is then retweeted and receives some comments.
Posts an instagram picture with a screenshot of the game and receives likes.
Does a twitch stream with 10 viewers.
Does a Facebook post that they are playing Tale of Toast.

You have until Friday the 3rd of March at 00:01 (AM) UTC to do as much as possible.
Once you have done the things you wanted to do, email hello@taleoftoast.com with the following:
[list]
[*] Links to your posts/comments/videos/etc.
[*] Screenshots where links are not possible.
[/list]

The weekend after that, we will be announcing the winners and send out the Crumbs Rewards to all the participants.
Austin and Fredrik will be making the final decision on how many crumbs each participants get and who the winner is, and the decisions are final.


[h1]Limited Edition Crumbs Item[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30651748/85af5741524512765aabf10c033e445b8712f6b8.gif[/img]
The "Plain Toast" cosmetic item will Only be for sale during the first week of launch (it will be removed from the Crumbs Shop on the 3rd of March 2018 at 00:01 (AM) UTC.
After that, the only way for someone to obtain this specific (and most likely ultra rare) item is to trade it with other players for Crumbs Bonds (it is not tradable for anything else) in an amount that is completely up to the player selling the "Plain Toast" item.
While the item is in the shop, you cannot trade it, but after it is removed from the crumbs shop you will be able to trade it with other players. 


[h1]Changes[/h1]
For the past three weeks, we have done hundreds of changes. They are far too many to be listed here, and we want to give you the pleasure of discovering the changes on your own, but some the highlights are:
[list]
[*] Increased movement speed.
[*] You are no longer locked for 3 turns during PvE combat (PvP combat is still like this until we have added a melee rooting skill)
[*] Part of the main quest chain has been implemented.
[*] A temporary level cap has been set to Level 30 (even though we have content to level 60). The reason for this is that we want to ensure there are no major issues for the first two weeks that cause problems with leveling or such. For the same reason, the bridge at Blue River Crossing has fallen into the water.
[*] Lots of updates related to balancing (skills, damage, stats, etc.).
[/list]


[h1]Thank you for Alpha testing![/h1]
The feedback and bug reports we've received during the alpha testing has been extremely important to us, thank you for all your effort and dedication to making this a great game!
As a very small token of appreciation, we have given those who took part of Alpha testing a unique title (can be enabled under the "Social Menu") only given to those who took part of alpha testing, and it is bound to their account name.
We're still working on being able to give each alpha tester a unique crumbs item, but as we do not yet have that functionality we will need to give that to you later.

Of course, the testing does not end because we've entered Early Access. We will continue to improve the game during Early Access, the main difference being that the game is now accessible 24/7.

We hope you will enjoy playing Tale of Toast, and as always we appreciate your feedback and bug reports so we can continue improving the game! :)


[h1]Discord[/h1]
Feel free to head over to our Discord, if you want to have a chat with some of the other players: https://discord.gg/taleoftoast

notes.title: Starting from Early Access we will not be doing any more character wipes
notes.content:
As we've been getting some questions about this we figured it was best to make a post to clear up what will happen to characters after we enter Early Access:

- Everyone will be starting with empty accounts once Early Access goes live, so any progress made during Alpha testing is cleared (actually the Alpha databases are already wiped) to ensure everyone starts on equal terms on the 23rd of February.

- Once we enter Early Access (on the 23rd of February 2018) there are no plans to do character wipes again. That means you will always be keeping your progress from the 23rd of February 2018, including when the game goes from Early Access -> Full Release.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.51
notes.content:
[b]Quests[/b]
We have implemented a few placeholder quests just to try out the functionality of the quest system. We would love your feedback on how quests are found and presented (wisp / NPC interaction), not so much the quest content at this point as they are just generic placeholders.

We hope you will enjoy testing Tale of Toast, and as always we appreciate your feedback and bug reports! :)


[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Raw Meat is now a global drop for level 1-10 mobs.
[*] Can send/receive party, guild, private, trade and world messages from inside dungeons.
[*] Added armor categories to Crumbs shop to sort items.
[*] Added crumbs armor sets as a possible purchasing option for a discount (instead of buying them one by one).
[*] Can buy stacks of specific crumb shop items (instead of 1x per purchase, so 10x fireworks for example).
[*] Can buy a character rename scroll.
[*] Added new rare quality mail armor set which can be crafted.
[*] All settings are now saved locally.
[*] Added option to invert mouse y-axis.
[*] Added option to disable "move forward by pressing both mouse buttons".
[*] Added description to world map that describes what each icon means.
[*] Camera sensitivity now has decimal values.
[*] Camera sensitivity can no longer be set to 0.
[*] Fungibarrow now drops from Evil Mushrooms.
[*] Altered Fungibarrow stats to match the level it drops at.
[*] Moved Octopus boss to Dry Lake.
[*] Some temporary quests are now available (see note at the top).
[*] Can no longer enter dungeons while you have a skull.
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Roaming quest NPCs will now stop moving when a player is interacting with them.
[*] Quest items will no longer drop from mobs that drop the quest item after you have completed the quest.
[*] The Skip Dialogue button was moved to the bottom of the screen.
[*] Completing a quest and opening the log would not update the quest log properly.
[*] Dialogue button no longer covers text in the quest window.
[*] Scrolling on quest log is fixed.
[*] AoE Healing spells now work again.
[*] The roof on the house at Dry Lake did not use a LOD model.
[*] If you cancel the "exit game" count down, your client will no longer exit when it would have hit zero.
[*] Fixed raycasting issues with fences.
[*] Fixed issues with Forest Golems.
[*] Fixed an issue with Wisp quest triggers.
[*] You can no longer destroy crumb items.
[*] Adjusted octopus boss collider and position.
[*] Fixed quit game buttons (again).
[/list]


[h1]Discord[/h1]
Feel free to head over to our Discord, if you want to have a chat with some of the Alpha testers: https://discord.gg/taleoftoast

We have implemented a few placeholder quests just to try out the functionality of the quest system. We would love your feedback on how quests are found and presented (wisp / NPC interaction), not so much the quest content at this point as they are just generic placeholders.

We hope you will enjoy testing Tale of Toast, and as always we appreciate your feedback and bug reports! :)


[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Raw Meat is now a global drop for level 1-10 mobs.
[*] Can send/receive party, guild, private, trade and world messages from inside dungeons.
[*] Added armor categories to Crumbs shop to sort items.
[*] Added crumbs armor sets as a possible purchasing option for a discount (instead of buying them one by one).
[*] Can buy stacks of specific crumb shop items (instead of 1x per purchase, so 10x fireworks for example).
[*] Can buy a character rename scroll.
[*] Added new rare quality mail armor set which can be crafted.
[*] All settings are now saved locally.
[*] Added option to invert mouse y-axis.
[*] Added option to disable "move forward by pressing both mouse buttons".
[*] Added description to world map that describes what each icon means.
[*] Camera sensitivity now has decimal values.
[*] Camera sensitivity can no longer be set to 0.
[*] Fungibarrow now drops from Evil Mushrooms.
[*] Altered Fungibarrow stats to match the level it drops at.
[*] Moved Octopus boss to Dry Lake.
[*] Some temporary quests are now available (see note at the top).
[*] Can no longer enter dungeons while you have a skull.
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Roaming quest NPCs will now stop moving when a player is interacting with them.
[*] Quest items will no longer drop from mobs that drop the quest item after you have completed the quest.
[*] The Skip Dialogue button was moved to the bottom of the screen.
[*] Completing a quest and opening the log would not update the quest log properly.
[*] Dialogue button no longer covers text in the quest window.
[*] Scrolling on quest log is fixed.
[*] AoE Healing spells now work again.
[*] The roof on the house at Dry Lake did not use a LOD model.
[*] If you cancel the "exit game" count down, your client will no longer exit when it would have hit zero.
[*] Fixed raycasting issues with fences.
[*] Fixed issues with Forest Golems.
[*] Fixed an issue with Wisp quest triggers.
[*] You can no longer destroy crumb items.
[*] Adjusted octopus boss collider and position.
[*] Fixed quit game buttons (again).
[/list]


[h1]Discord[/h1]
Feel free to head over to our Discord, if you want to have a chat with some of the Alpha testers: https://discord.gg/taleoftoast

notes.title: Early Access launch details and Birthday!
notes.content:
On January 25th, 2015, the first piece of code was commited to the Tale of Toast project, and thus today is its third birthday!

It's been a long journey, and your feedback has been invaluable to us, so we would like to take a moment to say Thank You to all those who have helped out! We are also very happy to finally announce the official Early Access launch date of Tale of Toast!

The schedule is as follows:
[list]
[*][b]January 26th - January 29th: Alpha test weekend[/b]
This is a regular alpha test weekend, and all those with an alpha key can play.

[*][b]February 2nd - February 16th: Balance testing[/b]
The balance testing phase will be done by a focus group of veteran players, and we will also allow our Patreon players (who pledge $3 or above) to take part of the balance testing as a small token of appreciation for their support.

[*][b]February 23rd: Tale of Toast Launch[/b]
This is the date you've been waiting for - the date when Tale of Toast will be playable each and every day! All databases (including character data) will be wiped so everyone starts with empty accounts. There will be no more wipes after this date. There will be servers in EU and USA. Will you be the first one to max out your character on the live servers?

Windows, OSX and Linux is supported.
[/list]

[h1]Discord[/h1]
Feel free to head over to our Discord, if you want to have a chat with some of the Alpha testers or Austin and Fredrik, the developers behind Tale of Toast: https://discord.gg/taleoftoast

notes.title: Patch 0.1.50
notes.content:
We hope you will enjoy testing Tale of Toast this weekend (it will be up 2 hours from this post), and as always we appreciate your feedback and bug reports! :)
Feel free to head over to our Discord, if you want to have a chat with some of the Alpha testers: https://discord.gg/taleoftoast

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] You can now set the same key on your keyboard to be used for multiple actions.
[*] Moved "Stay Behind Target" setting to the Controls Tab in the Settings Menu.
[*] Improvements to the quest system, with a very brief preview over at John's Farm.
[*] If you hold both left and right mouse button, the character will now run forward.
[*] If you have autorun enabled, and rotate the camera, the character will rotate in the direction you are facing.
[*] Added a Silver Chariot mount.
[*] Added an Octopus world boss.
[*] Enabling Grass should now have less FPS impact on your computer than before.
[*] Rain should no longer have as large FPS impact on your computer.
[*] General speed improvements.
[*] Added View Distance slider in Graphics Settings.
[*] Designer Patron lists are now shown in credits and on statue of heroes.
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Gave a nameless guard in Brightwyn a name.
[*] GIF Recorder now records to the proper location.
[*] Fixed a bug where if you had a previous character deleted without a breadbox, you could get stuck on Login.
[*] The Jealous, Chicken, Show Your Playtime/Gold/Skull emotions no longer use the Insult emotion.
[*] Fixed issue with "Exit Game" button.
[*] Fixed issues with the Bread GUI.
[*] Status effect icons on target info will now show up correctly.
[*] You can now use magic spells against the player you are locked in melee combat with in 1vs1 zones.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.1.49
notes.content:
Patreon
Want to pre-register your character name, name an NPC, weapon or other things and support the continued development of Tale of Toast? You can now become a Patron at https://www.patreon.com/taleoftoast , and for as little as $1 per month, you will be given a special role on Discord as well as your name in the credits in the game If you pledge a little more ($3), you'll gain special access to #patrons which contains insider information, earlier patch notes etc More than that and you'll reap even greater benefits, which can be seen on our Patreon page

We hope you will enjoy testing Tale of Toast, and as always we appreciate your feedback and bug reports! :)
Feel free to head over to our Discord, if you want to have a chat with some of the Alpha testers: https://discord.gg/taleoftoast

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] An inventory with infinite slots where Crumbs items are placed (Bread Box).
[*] There is now a Mushroom Mount.
[*] You can now equip the Winter Hat.
[*] Added loot boxes and fireworks for new year.
[*] Your fastest race time is now stored.
[*] The game can now run in background, which means that maximised full screen ( http://help.taleoftoast.com/article/13-borderless-window ) should now work better.
[*] GIF recorder now shows where it saved the recording and updated save folder.
[*] Increased drop chance of Mushroom Spores, Bunny Ears, Bunny Leather and Bunny Teeth.
[*] Default keys for strafe left and right are now A and D, while turning is now Q and E by default.
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Mouse Sensitivity option now works again.
[*] You can now rebind the Rotate Camera button again.
[*] You can now bind multiple mouse buttons to multiple actions again.
[*] Splash screen is no longer always shown even if its deselected in options.
[*] The second action bar option is now loaded correctly on startup.
[*] Fixed issue where you could damage guards with AoE they wouldn't attack back.
[*] Fixed issue where if you targeted a player and they took damage the target UI would not update.
[*] You can no longer trick the game by swapping weapons mid-attack.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.1.48
notes.content:
Winter Festival
The Winter Festival has come to Astaria, with Winter Festival bags spawning across the lands containing gifts to the players Father Winter is sure to make an appearance as well, but in this harsh land he may not be as good as you'd expect

Second Action Bar
As per popular request, we have now added a second action bar to the game. You can enable it in settings.
We hope you will enjoy testing Tale of Toast tomorrow (which starts at 00:00 PST / 03:00 EST / 07:00 UTC / 08:00 CET), and as always we appreciate your feedback and bug reports! :)
Feel free to head over to our Discord, if you want to have a chat with some of the Alpha testers: https://discord.gg/taleoftoast

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Winter Festival is here!
[*] Objects can now spawn on specific dates.
[*] Implemented Steam trading cards.
[*] Added and Removed some loading screen images.
[*] Implemented black wings.
[*] Removed camera rotation smoothing.
[*] Meteor now have additional impact graphics.
[*] Added an additional action bar.
[*] Oasis and Race Track added to world map.
[*] Implemented a new audio mixer.
[*] You can now reset all settings by starting game with -reset ( http://help.taleoftoast.com/article/17-reset-settings ).
[*] Created a new and improved Settings Manager which updates settings without having to press Apply (excluding resolution changes).
[*] Some humanoids now drop Bread, which can be cooked to make Toast.
[*] Trade Supplies vendors now sell stacks of 99 Empty Bottles.
[*] Guild MOTD text is no longer limited.
[*] /who will now also show players level.
[*] Added chat command to send and accept friend requests ( /help to see them).
[*] A message is now shown in chat when you enable walking (and also how to disable it).
[*] Removed fog patches from South Highland Moor.
[*] The Required Material counts no longer include high quality materials unless you have the option enabled.
[*] Vendor items that are bought with other items now display the required item icon instead of the gold icon next to the price.
[*] Lowered price of Iron Spear/Mace recipes.
[*] Added /showskull, /jealous and /chicken emotes.
[*] Removed MiaMia.
[*] You always succeed in gathering food (such as cabbage) as long as you have the required Cooking level.
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Mowed the grass at Abandoned Fortress.
[*] Guards can attack you after the skull disappears.
[*] The game should now always initially start on the correct desktop resolution for new players.
[*] If you leave the client open for a long time on the title screen and then hit connect, you got stuck on "Establishing Connection".
[*] Bunny, Runic, Enchanted and Medium leather sets did not have any icons.
[*] Cooked Savory Meat was missing from tradeskills.
[*] Low quality setting causes issues with LOD (roof would not disappear when zoomed out max for example).
[*] Settings Manager updates resolution every time you run the game.
[*] The Leaf vanity item would wiggle/shake around uncontrollably when moving around.
[*] Arrow rain did not show a circle for players when being active.
[*] Dead players that respawn would sometimes turn invisible.
[*] You were able to sort your inventory while trading or mailing items, causing it to trade or mail the incorrect item (from the senders perspective).
[*] You could walk through the walls in a house in Port Durville.
[*] You could get stuck behind the door in Johns Farm.
[*] Some trees in westmallow were above ground.
[*] You could walk to an area you shouldnt be able to from Azraq.
[*] You could get stuck by the Florin Cemetery gate.
[*] Sometimes when you killed a mob, the target ui wasn't removed.
[*] Medium Boars had the old graphics.
[*] Fireworks weren't loud enough.
[*] Zombie Murderer is no longer blocked in chat filter.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.1.47
notes.content:
Race Track
We have added a Race Track on the west side of Florin City. The Race Track is a place where you can compete against each other on mounts (max +40% increase) each time the clock hits 12:00(AM) in-game, but be sure to not use any disallowed substances while racing as it will disqualify you. Trying to take shortcuts on the track will also slow you down, and there is a small fee to enter. The winner of each race gets a token as an award, which can be traded in for items! There is also a participation award, and with enough of those you can trade them for a winner token. We will be adding a highscore for the fastest racers in an upcoming patch.


We hope you will enjoy testing Tale of Toast tomorrow (which starts at 00:00 PST / 03:00 EST / 07:00 UTC / 08:00 CET), and as always we appreciate your feedback and bug reports! :)
Feel free to head over to our Discord, if you want to have a chat with some of the Alpha testers: https://discord.gg/taleoftoast

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] You can now see and send world chat and trade chat messages from inside instances.
[*] Instances will now give warnings when the server is going down for maintenance.
[*] Added pig/boar SFX.
[*] Added pig/boar mounts.
[*] If you left click something, and then left click it again, it will behave like the right click button.
[*] AoEs will now give a skull to you if another player runs into the AoE circle.
[*] Adjusted the model for pigs/boars used for Skinning.
[*] Added mailbox to Albahr
[*] You can now fly from Nora to Clearwolf and Wyntervale (and opposite).
[*] Increased flight path cost for end game flight paths, and lowered cost for beginner area flight paths.
[*] You can rebind the cancel target button.
[*] Debuffs are now cleared on death.
[*] "Out of Mana" message will now also display as a message on the screen rather than only in chat.
[*] Added Craftable Spears and Maces (thanks Kitsune for the models!).
[*] Using town portal will now stop your movement-
[*] Moved Alchemy trainer and Banker more apart as they caused issues when close together.
[*] None of the enemies in Brightwyn Forest will no longer flee at low HP.
[*] Added Statue of Heroes that shows Patrons at that tier.
[*] Patrons are now shown in in-game Credits.
[*] Added Racing Event! Find the starting point to the west of Florin City. It starts whenever the in-game time hits  12:00/12pm.
[*] You can now press the Jump key while mounted to give your mount a boost.
[*] Increased minimum chance to hit/get hit to 25% (used to be 5%).
[*] Added Corgi mount.
[*] Increased drop rate to alchemy material drops.
[*] Treasure Goblin will now always drop a Treasure Key.
[*] Turtle mount now requires you to be level 1 or above.
[*] Created Oasis in Amir Desert for fishing.
[*] There is now a /showplayed command.
[*] You now get a proper error message when trying to create a guild without a Guild Charter.
[*] Added effect when a trade skill station is depleted.
[*] Adjusted player targeting to keep your current target when moving with the mouse (use ESC or click the target window to deselect current target)
[*] Can now move the target UI
[*] Chicken mount item is now Rare (blue) quality (up from Common (white))
[*] Made some internal server improvements
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] There is no longer a "Right Click to Sell" tooltip on items that cannot be sold.
[*] One of the long hair female hairstyles no longer acts off when moving around.
[*] Killing something with an AoE in one hit will now properly grant item drops.
[*] Fireworks can no longer be heard from anywhere.
[*] You can no longer get stuck in the Albahr fountain.
[*] Adjusted some swords which couldn't be sold.
[*] Hopefully fixed the issue with instances becoming unavailable after a while.
[*] All fireworks will now go off.
[*] Using scroll of rebirth will no longer remove debuffs.
[*] Some potion recipes were purple, with their output being blue.
[*] You can no longer walk down the cliff by Brimstone Caverns to get stuck.
[*] Grass in the new fishing area near Nora is no longer in the air.
[*] Ores on the path from Brightwyn to Seven Oaks should no longer spawn far down by the water.
[*] Magic Cucumber now uses a cucumber model on the ground.
[*] Disconnecting while looting a node will no longer break the node.
[*] You can no longer mount while sitting.
[*] Players should no longer flicker.
[*] Moved some trees in Westmallow that were above ground.
[*] All buttons in the in-game menu now got SFX when pressing them.
[*] Pressing the quest button will now open the empty quest log.
[*] Enabled Sheep and Boars in Hundred Trees Forest again.
[*] Adjusted Zombie mount growl volume.
[*] Some of the torches in Finhallow were below ground.
[*] Wyntervale Weaponsmith anvil is no longer floating in the air.
[*] Blacksmith in Albahr now sells more Enchanted Arrows and Traps.
[*] You can now see Target UI again.
[*] You no longer start walking towards the graveyard when you die.
[*] Pants icons are now working properly again.
[*] Should no longer be able to cast multiple spells at once
[*] The "I'm Stuck" feature should now work properly
[*] Guards will now attack skulled players once again
[*] Fixed an issue with attaching items to letters
[*] John's Farm now correctly displays a green shield next to it instead of a yellow skull
[*] Fixed some building colliders that were causing players to get stuck in the walls
[*] Pets no longer fall through the Florin Arena floor
[*] Fixed some player movement issues
[*] Fixed /showgold emote
[*] Fixed Discord Rich Presence issue
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.1.46
notes.content:
[b]Discord Rich Presence[/b]
We have integrated Discord Rich Presence!
With this, you can let others see that you're playing Tale of Toast and your character name, character level, and what instance you're currently in.
To enable this open Discord and go into User Settings, Games and enable "Display currently running game as a status message".
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30651748/1ade6d7481f188b6a239278cc340710f8b19dbbb.png[/img]

[b]Chicken Mount[/b]
The ever so alluring chicken mount have arrived to the world of Astaria! To have a chance of getting it you simply need to kill chickens. The drop chance? Not high.

[b]Optimized house models[/b]
We have optimized the house models across the world, which should hopefully mean you get a bit higher FPS. We are working on other optimizations too though, so stay tuned!

[b]Decreasing rubber banding[/b]
Improvements have been done to decrease rubber banding when going in/out of houses or next to fences.

We hope you will enjoy testing Tale of Toast tomorrow (which starts at 00:00 PST / 03:00 EST / 07:00 UTC / 08:00 CET), and as always we appreciate your feedback and bug reports! :)
Feel free to head over to our Discord, if you want to have a chat with some of the Alpha testers: https://discord.gg/taleoftoast

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] You now need to stand still for 10 seconds before you can log out.
[*] Created unique color schemes for all cloth and leather tradeskill armor sets.
[*] All Tier 1 recipes are now known from the start.
[*] Integrated Discord Rich Presence.
[*] Created two new fishing areas where the rivers meet at Nora and Blue River Crossing.
[*] Moved the old Trade Supplies vendor in Brightwyn to the square, and added two additional Trade Supplies vendors in Brightwyn.
[*] All gathering nodes in Brigthwyn Forest will now spawn at random locations.
[*] Created unique textures for Linen and Silk sheep.
[*] Reduced price for Tortilla and Cheese.
[*] You can now attack guild members in the arena (this is temporary for this patch as players wanted to test out PvP against guild members)
[*] Added mailbox to Clearwolf.
[*] Melee combat no longer forces you to target the enemy that you're in combat with.
[*] Melee combat is now slowed down for untargeted players.
[*] Improved group frame user interface.
[*] Arena kills no longer count towards PvP kills in highscore.
[*] Replaced enemy / npc target detection with a better method.
[*] Snarltooth will now drop better items more often.
[*] Lowered the amount of mobs in Orc Camp.
[*] Updated the terrain in Wyntervale.
[*] Disabled PvP in John's Farm.
[*] Combat XP is no longer shown in general chat window if Combat log is disabled for general chat window.
[*] Added /showgold emote
[*] Improvements to decrease rubber banding when going in/out of houses or next to fences.
[*] Increased HP for bosses
[*] There is now only one firework, which shoots a random firework.
[*] All bosses now have the same run speed as King Tirion.
[*] Increased Aggro range for elites around bosses.
[*] Optimized house models.
[*] Added Sheep pet.
[*] Added Chicken pet.
[*] Added Rooster pet.
[*] Added audio to Zombie mount.
[*] Added audio to Wolf mount.
[*] Added audio to Dragon mount.
[*] Created Chicken Mount.
[*] Removed ability to enable PvP prior to level 5.
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Sending mails will now send items based on the item slot, rather than the item id. You should no longer send the wrong item.
[*] The Default resolution when starting the game for the first time is no longer 640x480, but the current resolution of your monitor.
[*] The target ring for a mob will now disappear if you die, instead of being at the location where the enemy was when it died.
[*] You will no longer attack another player if you have them selected and write something in chat that contains the letter "v".
[*] Using Tab to switch chat channel will no longer swap your target.
[*] Fixed issue where you could get stuck in game.
[*] You can no longer use "Stuck" while on a flight path to get Really stuck.
[*] Enemies should hopefully no longer get stuck pathfinding to the same point over and over.
[*] AoE spells now work when you have a target selected.
[*] You can now open trade skill window when crafting.
[*] You can no longer cast multiple spells at the same time.
[*] You can no longer attack yourself by first casting a heal and then hitting "V" while targetted.
[*] NPCs that don't move are no longer spawned under the floor in buildings.
[*] You can no longer attack guards with "V" after targetting them.
[*] Florin City's walls now show up on minimap
[*] The stat reset button in the stat window now works.
[*] /played now shows the amount of days played again (instead of just hours and seconds).
[*] You can no longer initiate a trade when the dungeon ends, as it could cause item losses.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.1.46
notes.content:
[b]Discord Rich Presence[/b]
We have integrated Discord Rich Presence!
With this, you can let others see that you're playing Tale of Toast and your character name, character level, and what instance you're currently in.
To enable this open Discord and go into User Settings, Games and enable "Display currently running game as a status message".
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30651748/1ade6d7481f188b6a239278cc340710f8b19dbbb.png[/img]

[b]Chicken Mount[/b]
The ever so alluring chicken mount have arrived to the world of Astaria! To have a chance of getting it you simply need to kill chickens. The drop chance? Not high.

[b]Optimized house models[/b]
We have optimized the house models across the world, which should hopefully mean you get a bit higher FPS. We are working on other optimizations too though, so stay tuned!

[b]Decreasing rubber banding[/b]
Improvements have been done to decrease rubber banding when going in/out of houses or next to fences.

We hope you will enjoy testing Tale of Toast tomorrow (which starts at 00:00 PST / 03:00 EST / 07:00 UTC / 08:00 CET), and as always we appreciate your feedback and bug reports! :)
Feel free to head over to our Discord, if you want to have a chat with some of the Alpha testers: https://discord.gg/taleoftoast

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] You now need to stand still for 10 seconds before you can log out.
[*] Created unique color schemes for all cloth and leather tradeskill armor sets.
[*] All Tier 1 recipes are now known from the start.
[*] Integrated Discord Rich Presence.
[*] Created two new fishing areas where the rivers meet at Nora and Blue River Crossing.
[*] Moved the old Trade Supplies vendor in Brightwyn to the square, and added two additional Trade Supplies vendors in Brightwyn.
[*] All gathering nodes in Brigthwyn Forest will now spawn at random locations.
[*] Created unique textures for Linen and Silk sheep.
[*] Reduced price for Tortilla and Cheese.
[*] You can now attack guild members in the arena (this is temporary for this patch as players wanted to test out PvP against guild members)
[*] Added mailbox to Clearwolf.
[*] Melee combat no longer forces you to target the enemy that you're in combat with.
[*] Melee combat is now slowed down for untargeted players.
[*] Improved group frame user interface.
[*] Arena kills no longer count towards PvP kills in highscore.
[*] Replaced enemy / npc target detection with a better method.
[*] Snarltooth will now drop better items more often.
[*] Lowered the amount of mobs in Orc Camp.
[*] Updated the terrain in Wyntervale.
[*] Disabled PvP in John's Farm.
[*] Combat XP is no longer shown in general chat window if Combat log is disabled for general chat window.
[*] Added /showgold emote
[*] Improvements to decrease rubber banding when going in/out of houses or next to fences.
[*] Increased HP for bosses
[*] There is now only one firework, which shoots a random firework.
[*] All bosses now have the same run speed as King Tirion.
[*] Increased Aggro range for elites around bosses.
[*] Optimized house models.
[*] Added Sheep pet.
[*] Added Chicken pet.
[*] Added Rooster pet.
[*] Added audio to Zombie mount.
[*] Added audio to Wolf mount.
[*] Added audio to Dragon mount.
[*] Created Chicken Mount.
[*] Removed ability to enable PvP prior to level 5.
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Sending mails will now send items based on the item slot, rather than the item id. You should no longer send the wrong item.
[*] The Default resolution when starting the game for the first time is no longer 640x480, but the current resolution of your monitor.
[*] The target ring for a mob will now disappear if you die, instead of being at the location where the enemy was when it died.
[*] You will no longer attack another player if you have them selected and write something in chat that contains the letter "v".
[*] Using Tab to switch chat channel will no longer swap your target.
[*] Fixed issue where you could get stuck in game.
[*] You can no longer use "Stuck" while on a flight path to get Really stuck.
[*] Enemies should hopefully no longer get stuck pathfinding to the same point over and over.
[*] AoE spells now work when you have a target selected.
[*] You can now open trade skill window when crafting.
[*] You can no longer cast multiple spells at the same time.
[*] You can no longer attack yourself by first casting a heal and then hitting "V" while targetted.
[*] NPCs that don't move are no longer spawned under the floor in buildings.
[*] You can no longer attack guards with "V" after targetting them.
[*] Florin City's walls now show up on minimap
[*] The stat reset button in the stat window now works.
[*] /played now shows the amount of days played again (instead of just hours and seconds).
[*] You can no longer initiate a trade when the dungeon ends, as it could cause item losses.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.1.45
notes.content:
We're currently focusing on getting the core mechanics done for the early access launch, and because of that there are fewer content changes this time around.
A big change though is that you now got Object Targeting. This means that you can either select an enemy by left clicking on it or TAB between targets, and then either use a hotkey on your action bar to cast a skill, or hit "v" to melee/ranged attack the selected target.
We've also re-implemented quest system features, but we are waiting with activating the story line until for when we hit Early Access.

We hope you will enjoy testing the game tomorrow (which starts at 00:00 PST / 03:00 EST / 07:00 UTC / 08:00 CET), and as always we appreciate your feedback and bug reports! :)
Feel free to head over to our Discord, if you want to have a chat with some of the Alpha testers: https://discord.gg/taleoftoast

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Implemented Object Targeting (see notes above).
[*] Quest updates (no main story activated).
[*] Added the ability to add multiple servers for launch.
[*] Turned Halloweed ghost into a pet.
[*] There are now mana versions of Fish.
[*] You can now select what type of information you want shown in the general chat tab.
[*] Hovering over another player with vanity items on them will now show their actual equipment.
[*] Added notification to group chat when a group invite is sent by the leader.
[*] Added graveyard to Clearwolf.
[*] Albahr Blacksmith now sells more enchanted arrows and snare traps.
[*] Potions now have their duration in their description.
[*] Players are now informed how to open the social menu when getting a friend request.
[*] Treasure Keys now stack to 15.
[*] Rubies now stack.
[*] There is now a circle that shows the casting range of the spell you want to cast (added last alpha test).
[*] Scroll of rebirth is no longer usable in combat (changed last alpha test).
[*] Increased the stats/skill reset in the GUI from max level 5 to 10 (changed last alpha test).
[*] Ears are no longer sellable (changed last alpha test).
[*] Increase size of interaction spheres around woodcutting stations (changed last alpha test).
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed the visual radius for casting non-aoe spells (it was too short).
[*] Fixed so the grass will no longer turn black during the night.
[*] Adjusted some trees in Westmallow and Nora that were sticking out of the ground.
[*] Fixed aspect ratio of Mineral Ruins loading picture.
[*] Dropping items in the No-Risk PvP Arena should no longer have them fall through the floor.
[*] Gathering SFX no longer plays twice on successful attempts.
[*] Boss in Crimson Catacombs will now drop a Ruby from time to time.
[*] Timestamps no longer changes color from time to time.
[*] Whirlwind can no longer hit players outside the level restriction limit.
[*] You can no longer gather two things at the same time.
[*] Corrupt Arrow and Dire Arrow now show what their effect does.
[*] Enemies should go back and forth less often when casting spells at them from far away.
[*] Sometimes, the scrollbar wouldn't show in a vendor window even if they had more items than what fit in the window.
[*] The graphical quality settings should no longer have the visual appearance of reverting from Medium to Low when restarting the game.
[*] Reset button in "Stats" now works (fixed last alpha test).
[*] Sit and Dance emotes are no longer mixed up (fixed last alpha test).
[*] Florin Arena chest no longer spawns under the arena floor (fixed last alpha test).
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.1.44
notes.content:
Halloween arrived early to the land of Astaria, which means there are temporary changes in scenery in some of the areas around the world!
Some of the things we have changed, based on your feedback, are that we've given back some xp to trade skills, and we have also made it a bit smoother to progress from Florin Forest to Lake Nora.

We hope you will enjoy testing the game tomorrow (which starts at 00:00 PST / 03:00 EST / 07:00 UTC / 09:00 CEST Friday the 20th of October), and as always we appreciate your feedback and bug reports! :)

Feel free to head over to our Discord, if you want to have a chat with some of the Alpha testers: https://discord.gg/taleoftoast

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Halloween decorations.
[*] There is now an Emote menu you can use to do emotes. You can still use emotes in the chat box too (type /emotes for a list).
[*] Added unique wooden log icons for each type of wood.
[*] Epic recipes for all types of armor (Cloth, Leather, Mail and Plate) can now all be found in all the dungeons.
[*] Alchemy items should now drop more frequently (let us know if you have issues with any of the alchemy drops, and we will look at them).
[*] Added unique sounds for Gathering and Woodcutting.
[*] All guards now have names.
[*] Levels below level 6 can now reset their skills and stats by pressing on the Reset button in the skills/stats interfaces. Those above level 6 can still use the scroll of rebirth from the Crumbs shop (nothing is charged during alpha when purchasing anything from the Crumbs shop).
[*] You can now select to always show system time.
[*] Improved Clock (AM/PM for 12h clocks, and fix for showing single minutes properly).
[*] Added fireworks that can be obtained from the Crumbs shop.
[*] Adjusted enemy levels in South Highland Moor to make the level progression better from Florin Forest -> South Highland Moor -> Lake Nora.
[*] If you try to mount while running, the player will now stop and attempt to mount.
[*] Pets will now adjust their speed depending on if you're walking or running.
[*] Adjusted some node locations in Amir Desert.
[*] Magic food you can gather in the world (such as magic cabbage) now have a different icon from regular food.
[*] Dressing Room and Equipment cameras are now disabled when not in use to increase some performance.
[*] Adjusted Lightning Bolt cast time from 4s to 2.5s.
[*] You can now press TAB to switch between world chat, chat, trade, etc.
[*] You can now type a channel and press enter to swap to it (for example /world) instead of having to press space after typing it.
[*] Decreased the amount of gold in chests.
[*] Mailboxes no longer close when having sent a letter.
[*] Increased the hitbox around the flowers that your mouse interacts with to show you're hovering over a flower.
[*] The slash effect is now shown when doing a critical hit, instead of just randomly.
[*] Added tradeskills checkbox for 'Use high quality materials' that determines if +materials are used for the craft or not.
[*] Increased rare mat requirements on rare leaf armor set
[*] Increased xp gain on crafting.
[*] Vanity items no longer shows the "If Equipped" window when hovering over them, as they do not affect stats.
[*] Added a banker to Clearwolf.
[*] Renamed "Texture Quality" to "Quality" in graphical settings, to better reflect that it does more than just changing the texture quality (implemented during last alpha).
[*] Adjusted some Crafting Material to be Uncommon instead of Rare (implemented during last alpha).
[*] Removed Quality option from Projectiles and Spawner crafts (implemented during last alpha).
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where if you disabled left click to move, then you couldn't select spell targets.
[*] Player nametags should no longer be below or in the middle of players when on a mount.
[*] Rares should no longer get stuck in the crystal at mineral ruins.
[*] Fixed issue with the colors of the timestamp becoming the wrong color.
[*] Fixed issue where if your inventory was full when you tried to craft something (by droping something on the floor then picking it up when you start) the item would craft but it will never spawn. It will now be droped on the ground if this happens.
[*] Tradeskill stations should no longer spawn inside houses.
[*] Tradeskill stations (such as mining nodes) should no longer float mid-air.
[*] Bear Warriors should no longer sink through the ground.
[*] You should no longer gain None XP when gathering.
[*] Fixed the directions signs by Orc Camp and Clearwolf.
[*] Mowed the grass in Bandit Camp.
[*] Fixed a tree by Abandoned Fortress which wasn't fully placed in the ground.
[*] Samuari Chestplate should now clip less on the player.
[*] You should no longer be able to see into the crimson church by looking at a specific angle.
[*] Spell Tooltips were showing incorrect information.
[*] You will no longer be able to gather from trade skill stations that require Cooking (such as Cucumber) unless you are at the correct Cooking level.
[*] Whirlwind will no longer do a double hit on the target you're currently fighting.
[*] Whirlwind will no longer damage your party members.
[*] Friend list is now cleared properly when switching characters.
[*] Fixed issue with mailing items with a prefix.
[*] Fixed issue with being unable to create a guild.
[*] Fixed loading screens that had strange aspect ratios, resulting in strange looking images.
[*] The Copper Headknife is no longer green. 
[*] Wisp no longer tells you to speak with NPCs in the starting area (implemented during last alpha).
[*] Fixed issue where Runic Pickaxe and Meteore Pickaxe recipes would try to teach you Adamantite Pickaxe (implemented during last alpha).
[*] Tradeskill buttons should no longer disappear (implemented during last alpha).
[/list]

Some of the things we have changed, based on your feedback, are that we've given back some xp to trade skills, and we have also made it a bit smoother to progress from Florin Forest to Lake Nora.

We hope you will enjoy testing the game tomorrow (which starts at 00:00 PST / 03:00 EST / 07:00 UTC / 09:00 CEST Friday the 20th of October), and as always we appreciate your feedback and bug reports! :)

Feel free to head over to our Discord, if you want to have a chat with some of the Alpha testers: https://discord.gg/taleoftoast

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Halloween decorations.
[*] There is now an Emote menu you can use to do emotes. You can still use emotes in the chat box too (type /emotes for a list).
[*] Added unique wooden log icons for each type of wood.
[*] Epic recipes for all types of armor (Cloth, Leather, Mail and Plate) can now all be found in all the dungeons.
[*] Alchemy items should now drop more frequently (let us know if you have issues with any of the alchemy drops, and we will look at them).
[*] Added unique sounds for Gathering and Woodcutting.
[*] All guards now have names.
[*] Levels below level 6 can now reset their skills and stats by pressing on the Reset button in the skills/stats interfaces. Those above level 6 can still use the scroll of rebirth from the Crumbs shop (nothing is charged during alpha when purchasing anything from the Crumbs shop).
[*] You can now select to always show system time.
[*] Improved Clock (AM/PM for 12h clocks, and fix for showing single minutes properly).
[*] Added fireworks that can be obtained from the Crumbs shop.
[*] Adjusted enemy levels in South Highland Moor to make the level progression better from Florin Forest -> South Highland Moor -> Lake Nora.
[*] If you try to mount while running, the player will now stop and attempt to mount.
[*] Pets will now adjust their speed depending on if you're walking or running.
[*] Adjusted some node locations in Amir Desert.
[*] Magic food you can gather in the world (such as magic cabbage) now have a different icon from regular food.
[*] Dressing Room and Equipment cameras are now disabled when not in use to increase some performance.
[*] Adjusted Lightning Bolt cast time from 4s to 2.5s.
[*] You can now press TAB to switch between world chat, chat, trade, etc.
[*] You can now type a channel and press enter to swap to it (for example /world) instead of having to press space after typing it.
[*] Decreased the amount of gold in chests.
[*] Mailboxes no longer close when having sent a letter.
[*] Increased the hitbox around the flowers that your mouse interacts with to show you're hovering over a flower.
[*] The slash effect is now shown when doing a critical hit, instead of just randomly.
[*] Added tradeskills checkbox for 'Use high quality materials' that determines if +materials are used for the craft or not.
[*] Increased rare mat requirements on rare leaf armor set
[*] Increased xp gain on crafting.
[*] Vanity items no longer shows the "If Equipped" window when hovering over them, as they do not affect stats.
[*] Added a banker to Clearwolf.
[*] Renamed "Texture Quality" to "Quality" in graphical settings, to better reflect that it does more than just changing the texture quality (implemented during last alpha).
[*] Adjusted some Crafting Material to be Uncommon instead of Rare (implemented during last alpha).
[*] Removed Quality option from Projectiles and Spawner crafts (implemented during last alpha).
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where if you disabled left click to move, then you couldn't select spell targets.
[*] Player nametags should no longer be below or in the middle of players when on a mount.
[*] Rares should no longer get stuck in the crystal at mineral ruins.
[*] Fixed issue with the colors of the timestamp becoming the wrong color.
[*] Fixed issue where if your inventory was full when you tried to craft something (by droping something on the floor then picking it up when you start) the item would craft but it will never spawn. It will now be droped on the ground if this happens.
[*] Tradeskill stations should no longer spawn inside houses.
[*] Tradeskill stations (such as mining nodes) should no longer float mid-air.
[*] Bear Warriors should no longer sink through the ground.
[*] You should no longer gain None XP when gathering.
[*] Fixed the directions signs by Orc Camp and Clearwolf.
[*] Mowed the grass in Bandit Camp.
[*] Fixed a tree by Abandoned Fortress which wasn't fully placed in the ground.
[*] Samuari Chestplate should now clip less on the player.
[*] You should no longer be able to see into the crimson church by looking at a specific angle.
[*] Spell Tooltips were showing incorrect information.
[*] You will no longer be able to gather from trade skill stations that require Cooking (such as Cucumber) unless you are at the correct Cooking level.
[*] Whirlwind will no longer do a double hit on the target you're currently fighting.
[*] Whirlwind will no longer damage your party members.
[*] Friend list is now cleared properly when switching characters.
[*] Fixed issue with mailing items with a prefix.
[*] Fixed issue with being unable to create a guild.
[*] Fixed loading screens that had strange aspect ratios, resulting in strange looking images.
[*] The Copper Headknife is no longer green. 
[*] Wisp no longer tells you to speak with NPCs in the starting area (implemented during last alpha).
[*] Fixed issue where Runic Pickaxe and Meteore Pickaxe recipes would try to teach you Adamantite Pickaxe (implemented during last alpha).
[*] Tradeskill buttons should no longer disappear (implemented during last alpha).
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.1.43
notes.content:
This week we have worked on fixing the bugs that were reported, and the two things that received most major adjustments were Guilds and Tradeskills.
The largest change in relation to Tradeskills is probably that Batch Crafting now gives the same amount of trade skill xp as a single crafting, and now got the same attempts per craft as single crafting. There are plenty of other trade skill changes done as well though, some being two (kind of) new gathering skills to level in!
With regards to Guilds you now have the ability to set a message of the day, can see bank logs in a separate view, and. There is also a lot of other changes done, so have a look below.

We hope you will enjoy testing the game tomorrow, and as always we appreciate your feedback and bug reports! :)

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Different areas now have different light colors, so it should now be easier to see items in the snowy areas.
[*] You can now also see guild members level when they are offline.
[*] Added Shield skill: Shield Bash.
[*] Added 2H skills: Bloodlust and Whirlwind.
[*] You can now spawn a fire where you can cook (requires Carpentry material and a Flint). Campfires also provide a buff to players around it.
[*] Removed Enchanted Arrow requirement from the first tier ranged skill.
[*] Lowered price of Enchanted Arrows to 1 gold.
[*] Adjusted arrow recipes to use Sticks instead of Lumber.
[*] Added Stick version of all lumber materials.
[*] Adjusted Glue recipes to use Paste instead of flowers.
[*] Added Paste versions of all glue materials.
[*] Split Botany into Botany and Woodcutting skills, and Paring into Shearing and Skinning skills.
[*] Separated trade skills list based on type (Gathering / Crafting).
[*] You can right click on online guild members and invite to party from guild window.
[*] Added an item that when used, spawns a random monster at your location (you don't suffer death penalties when dying to this monster).
[*] You can now set a guild message of the day if you are an officer or guild leader..
[*] Adjusted respawn timers and spawn radiuses for nodes.
[*] Added audio and icon effect on abilities that are ready to be used again after being on cooldown.
[*] Lower right menu will now sparkle when you have unspent points.
[*] Skill / spell icons in the menu now sparkle when you have unspent points.
[*] Item Requirement text is now red if you don't meet the requirements on item tooltips.
[*] Disabled crafting quality on consumables.
[*] Spell icons that you can not yet assign are now faded to indicate they can not be used.
[*] Skills are now removed from actionbar after using Scroll of Rebirth.
[*] Added guild activity log messages so you can see them in separate views (general and bank)
[*] Added combat level requirement on arrows.
[*] Arrows gained from crafting have been upped from 12 to 20 arrows. Due to this change, they are also now unsellable.
[*] Raw, Cooked and Magical meat icons are now different.
[*] Adjusted so Error Messages are shown no matter what chat tab you have open.
[*] Added audio for completing gathering actions.
[*] You can now double click on a skill in the action bar to cast it on yourself, if it is a single target heal spell. You can also hold SHIFT + Action key to self-cast.
[*] Enemies that eat items on ground (such as bunnies) will now grow in size for each item it consumes.
[*] Players now start with a bow, dagger and short sword.
[*] Adde Rare Bandit Leader at Bandit Camp.
[*] Made Rare mobs in Grendal Cemetery easier to spot.
[*] Moved Trade Skill Vendor to the main square in Brightwyn.
[*] Potions are now Uncommon items, and no longer global drops.
[*] Batch Crafting now gives the same amount of trade skill xp as a single crafting, and now got the same attempts per craft as single crafting.
[*] Removed combat XP generated by crafting.
[*] Lowered tradeskill XP Generated by crafting.
[*] You are now asked if you want to enter or leave a dunegon.
[*] You can now see information when a guild member was online last time (they must login after this update for this to show).
[*] Adjustments have been made to in preparation to the quests, so you can no longer interact with random NPCs.
[*] You can now hover your mouse over the in-game clock to see your system time.
[*] You can now consume Crumbs bonds to get Crumbs.
[*] Lowered Mahogany trees respawn time (from 10-90 minutes to 3-10 minutes) (changed during last alpha test).
[*] Added Cheese to Trade Supply vendors (changed during last alpha test).
[*] Lowered respawn times for Brightwyn Forest loot objects (mining nodes, botany nodes, etc.) so they will respawn a lot quicker for new players (changed during last alpha test).
[*] Increased the amount of Redheart logs and lowered their respawn time (from 10-90 minutes to 3-10 minutes) (changed during last alpha test).
[*] Increased standard alchemy potion effect duration to 20 minutes (from 5/6 minutes) (changed during last alpha test).
[*] Fire Shards, Lava Cores and Stones now stack to 50 (changed during last alpha test).
[*] Crimson NPCs now drop boots (changed during last alpha test).
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Bunnies (and other monsters) should hopefully not get out of sync any more in some occasions for clients.
[*] You can no longer see through the roof of the house in Sleeping Volcano from certain angles.
[*] Failing a craft attempt should no longer get you stuck in the crafting animation.
[*] Fixed issue with textures on the Blue River Crossing building glitching out sometimes.
[*] Trade skill buttons should no longer be duplicated in certain conditions.
[*] Loot objects should no longer spawn inside trees or other objects.
[*] It no longer says "Requires: Arrows" on bows.
[*] Berries that are in the initial mail that new players receive now got a proper icon.
[*] Fixed and issue where a player could get corrupted in a specific case.
[*] Quest text bubbles will now be shown on top of all other layers.
[*] You can now target/heal group members from the group ui again.
[*] Lowered the quality of "Low" quality setting, which should mean players get better FPS on Low quality setting.
[*] There should no longer be a big shadow circle following you around on Medium quality setting.
[*] Crafting rates on currently open recipe window are now updated when your skill levels up.
[*] Fixed issue with own name plate not showing properly.
[*] Fixed issue where if you opened your map before going into a dungeon it would stay open, and you couldn't close it unless you left the dungeon.
[*] Your queued quality actions while crafting are now removed below the required progress threshold.
[*] You should no longer get stuck in the dead or trade skill animations.
[*] Your character will no longer look like it levitates if you move forward while being in the stand-still jump animation.
[*] It will now show "Gathering attempt failed" instead of "Cooking attempt failed" when failing to gather a consumable.
[*] Login server will now properly shut down when servers shut down.
[*] Mobs will now respawn again in Brimstone Caverns (fixed during last alpha test).
[*] Players drop inventory on death again (fixed during last alpha test).
[*] There is now a line break between sit down and group commands in /help (fixed during last alpha test).
[*] You can no longer walk through the walls in the General Goods store in Kinborough (fixed during last alpha test).
[*] You no longer get a PvP message when reaching level 5 (fixed during last alpha test).
[*] Crimson cloth from crimson catacombs will now stack (fixed during last alpha test).
[/list]

tags.feature: You can now also see guild members level when they are offline.
Added Shield skill: Shield Bash.
Added 2H skills: Bloodlust and Whirlwind.
You can now spawn a fire where you can cook (requires Carpentry material and a Flint). Campfires also provide a buff to players around it.
Added Stick version of all lumber materials.
Added Paste versions of all glue materials.
Split Botany into Botany and Woodcutting skills, and Paring into Shearing and Skinning skills.
Separated trade skills list based on type (Gathering / Crafting).
You can right click on online guild members and invite to party from guild window.
Added an item that when used, spawns a random monster at your location (you don't suffer death penalties when dying to this monster).
You can now set a guild message of the day if you are an officer or guild leader..
Added audio and icon effect on abilities that are ready to be used again after being on cooldown.
Lower right menu will now sparkle when you have unspent points.
Skill / spell icons in the menu now sparkle when you have unspent points.
Item Requirement text is now red if you don't meet the requirements on item tooltips.
Disabled crafting quality on consumables.
Spell icons that you can not yet assign are now faded to indicate they can not be used.
Skills are now removed from actionbar after using Scroll of Rebirth.
Added guild activity log messages so you can see them in separate views (general and bank)
Added combat level requirement on arrows.
Raw, Cooked and Magical meat icons are now different.
Adjusted so Error Messages are shown no matter what chat tab you have open.
Added audio for completing gathering actions.
You can now double click on a skill in the action bar to cast it on yourself, if it is a single target heal spell. You can also hold SHIFT + Action key to self-cast.
Enemies that eat items on ground (such as bunnies) will now grow in size for each item it consumes.
Players now start with a bow, dagger and short sword.
Adde Rare Bandit Leader at Bandit Camp.
Made Rare mobs in Grendal Cemetery easier to spot.
Moved Trade Skill Vendor to the main square in Brightwyn.
Potions are now Uncommon items, and no longer global drops.
Batch Crafting now gives the same amount of trade skill xp as a single crafting, and now got the same attempts per craft as single crafting.
Removed combat XP generated by crafting.
You are now asked if you want to enter or leave a dunegon.
You can now see information when a guild member was online last time (they must login after this update for this to show).
Adjustments have been made to in preparation to the quests, so you can no longer interact with random NPCs.
You can now hover your mouse over the in-game clock to see your system time.
You can now consume Crumbs bonds to get Crumbs.
Added Cheese to Trade Supply vendors (changed during last alpha test).

tags.bug: Bunnies (and other monsters) should hopefully not get out of sync any more in some occasions for clients.
You can no longer see through the roof of the house in Sleeping Volcano from certain angles.
Failing a craft attempt should no longer get you stuck in the crafting animation.
Fixed issue with textures on the Blue River Crossing building glitching out sometimes.
Trade skill buttons should no longer be duplicated in certain conditions.
Loot objects should no longer spawn inside trees or other objects.
It no longer says "Requires: Arrows" on bows.
Berries that are in the initial mail that new players receive now got a proper icon.
Fixed and issue where a player could get corrupted in a specific case.
Quest text bubbles will now be shown on top of all other layers.
You can now target/heal group members from the group ui again.
There should no longer be a big shadow circle following you around on Medium quality setting.
Crafting rates on currently open recipe window are now updated when your skill levels up.
Fixed issue with own name plate not showing properly.
Fixed issue where if you opened your map before going into a dungeon it would stay open, and you couldn't close it unless you left the dungeon.
Your queued quality actions while crafting are now removed below the required progress threshold.
You should no longer get stuck in the dead or trade skill animations.
Your character will no longer look like it levitates if you move forward while being in the stand-still jump animation.
It will now show "Gathering attempt failed" instead of "Cooking attempt failed" when failing to gather a consumable.
Login server will now properly shut down when servers shut down.
Mobs will now respawn again in Brimstone Caverns (fixed during last alpha test).
Players drop inventory on death again (fixed during last alpha test).
There is now a line break between sit down and group commands in /help (fixed during last alpha test).
You can no longer walk through the walls in the General Goods store in Kinborough (fixed during last alpha test).
You no longer get a PvP message when reaching level 5 (fixed during last alpha test).
Crimson cloth from crimson catacombs will now stack (fixed during last alpha test).

tags.balance_change: Removed Enchanted Arrow requirement from the first tier ranged skill.
Lowered price of Enchanted Arrows to 1 gold.
Adjusted arrow recipes to use Sticks instead of Lumber.
Adjusted Glue recipes to use Paste instead of flowers.
Adjusted respawn timers and spawn radiuses for nodes.
Lowered the quality of "Low" quality setting, which should mean players get better FPS on Low quality setting.
Arrows gained from crafting have been upped from 12 to 20 arrows. Due to this change, they are also now unsellable.
Lowered Mahogany trees respawn time (from 10-90 minutes to 3-10 minutes) (changed during last alpha test).
Lowered respawn times for Brightwyn Forest loot objects (mining nodes, botany nodes, etc.) so they will respawn a lot quicker for new players (changed during last alpha test).
Increased the amount of Redheart logs and lowered their respawn time (from 10-90 minutes to 3-10 minutes) (changed during last alpha test).
Increased standard alchemy potion effect duration to 20 minutes (from 5/6 minutes) (changed during last alpha test).
Fire Shards, Lava Cores and Stones now stack to 50 (changed during last alpha test).
Crimson NPCs now drop boots (changed during last alpha test).

notes.title: Patch 0.1.42
notes.content:
As we are preparing to entering Early Access, we have created yet another patch for you to try out!
We have made quite a few changes, and some of the highlights are:

[b]Food Updates[/b]
We have removed food from vendors, so food from cooking and gathering is now the main source for health and mana.
Enemies will now drop various raw meats that may be cooked either on their own for health, or by adding ingredients for mana.
We have also added additional fruit stations around the world which provides health and mana when gathered, and they require various cooking levels to loot.

[b]Dungeon Adjustments[/b]
We have added a new dungeon, Brimstone Caverns, which requires level 55+ to enter.
We have also added fog of war to crimson dungeon and rare enemies to each cave that will sometimes spawn.

[b]Armor Sets[/b]
We have created some additional armor sets; rare leather, rare cloth, epic cloth and legendary mail.

[b]Crafting[/b]
Crafting Materials can now gain +quality, and when using materials with +quality on them you have a better chance of yielding higher stats results on the item you are making.
Crafter items with +quality also gets a higher item level now.

See the full list of new features, adjustments and bug fixes below.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] All NPCs now have random dialogue assigned to them in preparation to quests.
[*] Added child NPCs.
[*] Added Object Tooltip to house walls so you can hover them to see what type of house it is.
[*] Removed food from vendors.
[*] Created more food loot stations in the world.
[*] Enemies now drop various raw meat that can be cooked for Health or Mana.
[*] You can now see how many players you have killed, and what your total amount of deaths are.
[*] Scroll of Alpha Testing now gives level 25 in all trade skills as well.
[*] There is now an option to show your own name tag.
[*] A player with full inventory can now trade with another player, as long as the end result does not mean they have more than a full inventory.
[*] Damage AoE circles are now red.
[*] Prices of 40% mounts lowered to 5000 gold.
[*] Added level 10 mount in Seven Oaks, that gives 20% speed increase, for 2000 gold.
[*] You can no longer send mails to players you are ignoring, or who are ignoring you.
[*] Clicking on a trade skill station opens up the corresponding trade skill.
[*] Adjusted casting bar timer position
[*] Enchanted Arrow is no longer a projectile item.
[*] There is now an arrow that shows your direction your player is facing on the minimap and the world map.
[*] It is now shown in group chat when you loot something from a chest.
[*] Increased the amount of blooms to be equal to mining nodes.
[*] Made blooms easier to spot by increasing their size and using a few better models.
[*] Added timestamp option for chat.
[*] Rares should no longer spawn in the same order al lthe time.
[*] Removed guards from safe zones, and instead made skulled players attackable in them, to avoid locking skulled players out of those areas.
[*] Increased drop rates for alchemy materials that drop from enemies.
[*] Players can no longer attack guards or flight mounts.
[*] New players now get a welcome letter to their mailbox.
[*] The heads of players were made 10% smaller.
[*] Removed arrow requirement for bows, but arrows give additional damage compared to shooting without arrows. Because of this, arrows are now dropped on death.
[*] Made sheep and boar icons on the minimap a little smaller.
[*] Added sound effect for learning a recipe.
[*] Reduced health gained from Defense to 3 (down from 7).
[*] Added extra flavour text to an item quality depending on how good the quality of the item is.
[*] The possible equipment stat rolls are now closer together than they previously were.
[*] Enemies below levvel 3 now have 1/3 of their previous health, and 4-5 have 1/2 of their previous health.
[*] Friend list is now sorted by online friends first.
[*] Color of damage text done by local client is now white.
[*] Added batch crafting for arrows.
[*] Removed +Vitality on 1H axes and +Vitality on 2H swords.
[*] It now says "Offline" instead of "N/A" in the group gui.
[*] Adjusted name of Crackle Dagger to Crackle Axe (as it was actually an Axe and not a Dagger).
[*] There is now a server announcement when a player kills a world boss.
[*] Bosses no longer spawn immediately when server starts.
[*] Enemies now have a max level in each dungeon.
[*] Dungeons can now apply status effects when entering.
[*] If you leave the group while in a dungeon, you will be teleported out after a while.
[*] Players can no longer send group invites in dungeons.
[*] Crafting Materials can now have +quality.
[*] Crafted Equipment item with +quality gets a higher level
[*] Using Materials that have +quality on them will yield better stat results.
[*] Added Legendary Mail Set.
[*] Added Rare Leather Set.
[*] Added Epic Cloth Set.
[*] Added Rare Cloth Set.
[*] Added Leaf Umbrella.
[*] Added Samurai Helm.
[*] Added Japanese Masks.
[*] Added Sunglasses Trinket.
[*] The Crimson Catacombs dungeon is now available (level 20+) (changed during last alpha).
[*] Lowered quality of a couple globally dropped potions (changed during last alpha).
[*] Disabled respawning of mobs inside dungeons (changed during last alpha).
[*] Disabled respawning of chests inside dungeons (changed during last alpha).
[*] It is now possible to sit down while moving (changed during last alpha).
[*] Improved performance when switching chat tabs with lots of text (changed during last alpha).
[*] Adjusted aggressive types on enemies within Shadehallow Cemetery (changed during last alpha).
[*] Tier2 Trade skill recipes now cost 1/4 its previous price (changed during last alpha).
[*] Made it more clear what the tool bonus is for in the trade skills window (changed during last alpha).
[/list]


[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] If an enemy loses its target for some reason, it no longer get stuck.
[*] Walls should no longer overlap in Crimson Catacombs.
[*] Spell buffs no longer display the Miss combat text when applied.
[*] Fixed issue where if you unequip an item from your real slot that uses the same model as your equipped vanity slot, it would hide the item model.
[*] Grass should no longer turn black.
[*] Vendor Item scroll bar is now only shown when the list is large enough to require a scroll bar.
[*] You can no longer cast spells during the sitting/standing animation.
[*] The guild banker no longer talks every time you move things around in the bank.
[*] Recipe items for materials no longer list Accuracy as a random attribute chance.
[*] You can now heal players by clicking the group ui again.
[*] /<emote> <playername> now works again.
[*] Max damage on offhand weapons can no longer be lower than the Min damage amount.
[*] Channeling spells no longer counts up instead of down on their timer.
[*] NPCs/Enemies that doesn't move around will now return to their spawn position when out of combat.
[*] Crafting something in leather working and carpentry will no longer make the alchemy sound.
[*] Rare enemies and Boss enemies are now properly shown on the minimap.
[*] Fixed a typo on the Wisp Color GUI.
[*] Player crit chance was calculated incorrectly.
[*] The world map will no longer open if you are in a dungeon and click the "open map" icon.
[*] Guild activity window will now show the proper time when auditing.
[*] Fixed a fence in Seven Oaks that acted strangely.
[*] You can no longer rotate the camera left and right when writing a letter.
[*] Fixed issue with crafting attempts sometimes playing the failed SFX even when you succeed (fixed during last alpha).
[*] Fixed issue with status effect effects not being removed properly (fixed during last alpha).
[*] Fixed logout button (fixed during last alpha).
[*] Fixed quit button on Title menu (fixed during last alpha).
[*] Fixed a crafting issue with making quality attempts below 10% progress (fixed during last alpha).
[*] Removed splash screen on startup (fixed during last alpha).
[*] Fixed an issue with the minimap not being cleared properly (fixed during last alpha).
[*] NPCs does proper damage now (fixed during last alpha).
[*] Elite and Boss enemies will now aggro players no matter their level (fixed during last alpha).
[*] Applying status effects to targets no longer locks you in combat (fixed during last alpha).
[/list]

Thank you for taking the time to alpha test Tale of Toast, it is very appreciated and we hope you enjoy your time in Tale of Toast!

As always, free free to head over to https://discord.gg/taleoftoast if you want to have a chat with the developers and other players testing the game.
